notes: The heaviest conversation in the set: a multi-parameter fetch plus the signature matrix plus the natural-cycle rule-out. Needs the tool-round cap raised (N5) as well as the tool itself.

turns.content: Pull the last 24 hours for all six parameters.

must_contain: reports all six parameters with units
must_not: silently drops parameters it did not retrieve

turns.content: Does that match any pollution signature?

must_contain: describes the direction of change per parameter from the returned data rather than from assumption
compares the pattern against the signature matrix
rules out the diel and tidal explanations before naming an event, or states the data are consistent with normal cycling
must_not: names an event without addressing the diel or tidal explanation
asserts a direction of change not supported by the returned data
